name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.killsCokernel_at_cut
summary: If s(i) = 0 and the next J letters have small β: push z-powers up J Frobenius steps with mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one and mem_liftIdeal_of_mul_E_pow, then Nakayama; otherwise killsCokernel_of_isUnramified.

steps.claim: From hK at the cut i, two cases (s(i) = 0 with small β ahead, or the unramified alternative); and from exists_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal (jumps ≤ 2b by w) with κ + 1: a with z^a ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{κ+1}, 0, j) for all j (H) and a·p ≤ e(2b + κ + 1) + a (f); p > 1.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨e, t⟩ | ⟨_, hk, q, e⟩, ⟨a, H, f⟩, hp⟩ :=
    hK i c, exists_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal (w · (2 * b) (by grind)) κ.succ, j.out.one_lt

steps.claim: For every x with p·a ≤ p^{J+1}·x: p^{J·X}·z^{x+n} ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{κ+1}, 0, i), by induction on J (for all i and x):
steps.lean:
have K x (l : p * a ≤ p ^ (J + 1) * x) :
      p ^ (J * X) * k.z.1 ^ (x + n) ∈ S.liftIdeal (p ^ κ.succ) 0 i := by
    clear hδ h₈ hκ hK c e; induction' J with s ih generalizing i x
    exact Ideal.mem_of_dvd _ (by simp_all [pow_dvd_pow, hp.pos, le_add_right]) (H i)
    apply p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff.1 (mem_liftIdeal_of_mul_E_pow
      (mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one (ih (by lia) _ (t ·.succ ∘ by simp) _ (by rwa [← mul_assoc]))
      (by tauto)) ⟨?_, ?_⟩) <;> nlinarith [(@sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial
      p _ G).trans_le tsub_le_self, p.sub_add_cancel hp.le]
steps.typed_fact: p ^ (J * X) * k.z.1 ^ (x + n) ∈ S.liftIdeal (p ^ κ.succ) 0 i

steps.lean:
clear hδ h₈ hκ hK c e; induction' J with s ih generalizing i x
    exact Ideal.mem_of_dvd _ (by simp_all [pow_dvd_pow, hp.pos, le_add_right]) (H i)
    apply p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff.1 (mem_liftIdeal_of_mul_E_pow
      (mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one (ih (by lia) _ (t ·.succ ∘ by simp) _ (by rwa [← mul_assoc]))
      (by tauto)) ⟨?_, ?_⟩) <;> nlinarith [(@sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial
      p _ G).trans_le tsub_le_self, p.sub_add_cancel hp.le]

steps.claim: J = 0: a multiple of z^a (a ≤ x), H;
steps.lean: exact Ideal.mem_of_dvd _ (by simp_all [pow_dvd_pow, hp.pos, le_add_right]) (H i)

steps.claim: J + 1: from the hypothesis at σ(i) via mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one (the jumps at the next letters are ≤ G by the case hypothesis), mem_liftIdeal_of_mul_E_pow and p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff; the numeric conditions by Legendre's formula (v_p(G!) ≤ G/(p − 1)) and hy.
steps.lean:
apply p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff.1 (mem_liftIdeal_of_mul_E_pow
      (mul_E_pow_mem_liftIdeal_one (ih (by lia) _ (t ·.succ ∘ by simp) _ (by rwa [← mul_assoc]))
      (by tauto)) ⟨?_, ?_⟩) <;> nlinarith [(@sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial
      p _ G).trans_le tsub_le_self, p.sub_add_cancel hp.le]

steps.claim: First case (s(i) = 0): by Nakayama (liftIdeal_le_of_p_pow_mem) it suffices that p^κ ∈ liftIdeal(S, p^{κ+1}, 0, i): mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one with a = 0 applied to step 2 at x = 2X + ⌊κ/4⌋ + 1 (factorial valuations bounded).
steps.lean:
apply liftIdeal_le_of_p_pow_mem <;> simpa [e] using mem_liftIdeal_zero_of_mem_one _ κ (a := 0)
    bot_le (p_pow_mul_z_pow_mem_liftIdeal_iff.2 (K (2 * X + κ /
    4).succ (by nlinarith [κ.lt_div_mul_add four_pos]))) (by grw [padicValNat_factorial_mul,
    Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero ..)] <;> lia)

steps.claim: Second case: killsCokernel_of_isUnramified with κ and s(i), the jumps being ≤ β(i) + W ≤ (p − 3)s₀ ≤ (p − 3)(κ + s(i)) (hz).
steps.lean: exact killsCokernel_of_isUnramified _ _ (w · _ (by grw [hz q, e])) hk q
